model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for different models. The x-axis represents the Co-occurrence Number, with a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^1 to 10^3, and is labeled with values at intervals of 10^1. The y-axis represents ACC (%), with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 65, and is labeled at intervals of 5. The plot displays six lines, each representing a different model: Base (black, circle marker, solid line), FT (blue, triangle marker, solid line), IKE (red, triangle marker, solid line), MEND (brown, triangle marker, solid line), MEMIT (purple, circle marker, solid line), and ROME (green, square marker, solid line). The Base line starts at approximately 5 on the y-axis and decreases to around 2 as the Co-occurrence Number increases from 10^1 to 10^3. The FT line begins at around 10 and decreases to approximately 5 over the same range. The IKE line starts at about 15 and declines to roughly 7. The MEND line begins at around 35, remains relatively steady until a Co-occurrence Number of 10^2, and then decreases to approximately 20. The MEMIT line starts at around 40 and decreases to about 20. The ROME line begins at approximately 45 and gradually decreases to around 38.
